# Version 4.150.8 (Unreleased)
> **Raster and texture correctness**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.150.8 update fixes native raster-pipeline failures, region allocation, and texture sampling without changing managed APIs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Safer region and shader processing** — Prevents undersized region buffers for subdivided conics and contains failed runtime-shader stage construction instead of executing a partially constructed Raster Pipeline. ([#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543), [#5633](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5633))
- **Correct texture uploads and subset filtering** — Disables an unsupported GLES upload format for BGRA textures interpreted as RGBx and preserves subset clamps when nearest filtering could sample neighboring texels. Integer-relative one-to-one mappings retain their fast path. ([#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543))
